recv_send.detail: A responder receives encoded hello bytes and sends a nonempty hello reply; apply recv_send to that actual output. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

recv_take.detail: A nonempty Alice: hello Bob op is decoded and taken by the running Conn.recv in a permitted room; apply recv_take to that exact op. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

hold_reply_local.detail: Probe the actual id of a local secret with a nonempty have; one store contains the secret and the other lacks it. Prove RoomsAgree and both decode premises, then apply the theorem. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

hold_reply_local_premises.detail: A nonempty encoded have naming the synthetic chat op proves both decode premises. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

offer_shared.detail: Store Alice: hello Bob with a real write turn, prove a nonempty filed advertisement and id membership, then apply offer_shared: the advertised op is stored and its room is one of the connection's rooms. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

offer_stored.detail: Same stored chat and nonempty advertisement; apply offer_stored to its actual id. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

filed_send.detail: Bridge held/model execution for the concrete filed write; apply filed_send to a produced nonempty advertisement. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

tick_send.detail: A quiet tick at 30000 ms sends an actual keepalive; apply tick_send to that output. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

onWant_authorized.detail: A request for the stored chat id is indexed in the permitted room and actually joins the queue; apply onWant_authorized. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

onWant_all.detail: Prove maxIds/queue capacity and index authorization for a single chat op, then apply onWant_all. A control with no permitted room queues nothing. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

onWant_order.detail: Apply onWant_order to the nonempty authorized chat request. wantQueued separately establishes the added queue is nonempty. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

serveOwed_shown.detail: Apply serveOwed_shown to a chat op actually served from a nonempty wanted queue. Revoking the room suppresses service. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

serveOwed_hot.detail: A stored shown op is the one selected hot id from the wanted and fresh-write sets, so it is sent urgently even with zero bulk budget. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

serveOwed_head.detail: Prove positive byte budget, concrete nonempty queue, stored op and shown room, then apply serveOwed_head. Zero bulk budget serves nothing. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

serveOwed_fifo.detail: Apply serveOwed_fifo to the nonempty chat queue; servesHead separately establishes actual output. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

owed_within.detail: Apply owed_within with a positive 1024-byte budget to drain the nonempty queue. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

drop_iff_silent.detail: Apply the exact iff at 90001 ms; independent application at 90000 ms proves still live at the strict deadline. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

keepalive_sent.detail: Instantiate existing keepalive_runs, which constructs quiet-work and timing premises and applies keepalive_sent; actual output is a nonempty empty-have keepalive at 30000 ms. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

live_stays.detail: Instantiate live_runs, whose actual receive/tick history proves both scheduler and delivery premises for live_stays. Logical time live=3; not a real network scheduling guarantee. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.

stream_delivers.detail: Instantiate the existing non-vacuity witness: two nodes open sessions, write an op, exchange have/want/op, and the receiver stores it. Synthetic fixture; running generic sync code on a Unit family/held store, not Community membership or encrypted transport.
